note: Road Trips 2:3 lists a single "Weather Report Suite" of 16:19 between China Doll and the Jam. The corpus keeps the suite as three stripes and "Weather Report Suite" is deliberately absent from data/songs.json, so an unaided import dropped the song entirely. No tape settles the split either: gd1974-06-18.sbd.miller.89690.sbeok.flac16 gives one 26:08 track bundling the suite *and* the Jam after it, against the release's 16:19 + 9:28. That bundling had also mis-paired the file — the release's 9:28 Jam matched the tape's separate 3:21 It's A Sin Jam, swapping The Other One and the Jam and losing the second jam — so the running order was rebuilt to the one the release and the tape agree on: Row Jimmy > the suite > Jam > The Other One > a second Jam > Stella Blue. Split by ear by Jason, 2026-08-14: 1:22 / 4:40 / 10:17, summing exactly to 16:19.
